pkgmetadata.longdescription: Staticcheck is a state-of-the-art linter for the Go programming language. It uses static analysis to find bugs and performance issues, offer simplifications and enforce style rules. Beyond the staticcheck command itself, this package installs the structlayout family of tools, which display and optimise the in-memory layout of Go structs: structlayout, structlayout-optimize and structlayout-pretty.
